tagline: Because what is missing from history matters too.

hero.badge: THE WORLD WE HAVE PRESERVED • THE KNOWLEDGE WE OMITTED
hero.title_part1: We have preserved thousands of artifacts.
hero.title_part2: We have omitted the living voices behind them.
hero.subtitle: A cultural collection auditing platform for Indian heritage. Revealing metadata blind spots, measuring Cultural Coverage Debt, and establishing consent-first documentation priorities.

observatory.title: Subcontinental Collection Observatory
observatory.subtitle: Multi-dimensional audit of Indian cultural heritage records across 10 deterministic documentation dimensions.

matrix.title: Subcontinental Coverage Matrix
matrix.subtitle: A deterministic breakdown of documentation completeness across 9 cultural categories and 10 knowledge dimensions.

gaps.subtitle: Contrasting external authoritative benchmark existence against internal museum documentation completeness.

priorities.title: Consent-First Documentation Priorities
priorities.subtitle: Converting structural silences and documentation debt into actionable, ethical cultural preservation workflows.
priorities.consent_banner: CONSENT MANDATE: Living practitioner traditions require free, prior, and informed consent (FPIC) before any field documentation commences.

entities.title: Traditions, Monuments & Intangible Practices
entities.subtitle: Records are institutional documents; Heritage Entities are the living traditions, registered craft knowledge, and monuments themselves. Clustering records across museum and governmental sources closes documentation debt.
entities.search_placeholder: Search tradition or monument (e.g. Chhau, Pashmina, Konark)...

caveats.mandate: Absence of a record is never proof that a tradition, region or community has less heritage.
caveats.debt: Cultural Coverage Debt measures documentation completeness in the analyzed collection, never cultural value.
caveats.consent: Living practitioner knowledge requires free, prior and informed community consultation.
